meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 装上后,每次你新建或改动界面(网页或终端界面),它都会截图留证、跑两轮独立审查(设计系统/功能、视觉保真/中文字符),最后给你「通过/返修/不通过」的明确结论。
howto.when: 在你新建或改动任何界面后,或当你问页面、组件、终端界面看起来是否正常时触发。相关说法有“视觉QA”“截图比对”“界面不对”等。

say.text: 我刚改完这个页面,帮我做一轮完整视觉QA。
say.note: 会截图并跑两轮审查,给出通过或返修结论。

say.text: 对照这张设计稿,检查我的实现有没有偏差。
say.note: 会做像素比对,输出差异热点。

say.text: 检查这个终端界面有没有框线错位或中文截断。
say.note: 会跑 TUI 宽度检查,报告溢出和错位。

howto.what_en: After installation, whenever you create or change any UI (web or terminal), it captures screenshots/terminal evidence, runs two independent review passes (design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK), and ends with a clear PASS/REVISE/FAIL verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you build or modify any UI, or when you ask whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Keywords include "visual QA", "screenshot diff", "UI looks wrong", etc.

say_en.text: I just changed this page. Run a full visual QA.
say_en.note: Captures screenshots, runs both passes, then verdict.

say_en.text: Compare this design mock with my implementation for differences.
say_en.note: Runs pixel diff and outputs hotspot regions.

say_en.text: Check this TUI for border drift or CJK clipping.
say_en.note: Runs width check; reports overflow and misalignment.
